evidence.quote:
Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire
Pierre Computer Company, Inc
⁠
(opens in a new window)
. (“Pierre”), the company behind
Code Storage
⁠
(opens in a new window)
and a family of standout open-source developer tools.
The closing of the acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of regulatory approvals. Until closing, OpenAI and Pierre will remain separate and independent companies.
If you’ve browsed files or reviewed a change in the Codex app, you’ve already used Pierre’s Trees and Diffs libraries.

title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
displayTitle: OpenAI拟收购Pierre，补齐Codex的代码存储与审查工具
summary: OpenAI宣布拟收购Pierre Computer Company；其Trees与Diffs组件已用于Codex，交易仍待惯常条件及监管批准。
investorNote: 代码智能体并行工作增加Git系统与变更审查的负担。OpenAI将Pierre的工具和团队纳入Codex生态，能否形成开发者愿意迁移的工作流仍取决于收购完成后的产品整合。
narrative: OpenAI宣布拟收购Pierre Computer Company。Pierre的Trees与Diffs组件已经用于Codex浏览文件和审查改动，Code Storage则提供基于Git的代码存储与历史跟踪。**交易尚未完成，仍待监管批准等条件**；OpenAI称Pierre开源项目会继续开放。对编码Agent而言，竞争点正从模型生成代码延伸到并行修改后的版本管理和审查体验。

eventRelation.reason: 当日独立动作；与近两周已存事件的具体发生不同
